derivations.quote: Let $u,v$ be the exact stored forward outputs and $\widetilde u,\widetilde v$ the returned ones, all disk arrays. By bilinearity, $P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v)-P(u,v)=P(\widetilde u-u,\widetilde v)+P(u,\widetilde v-v)$. By the contraction bound for $P$, and norm at most $1$ of $\widetilde v$ and $u$, each term is less than $\delta$, so $\|P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v)-P(u,v)\|_\infty<2\delta$. With $\widetilde z=Q_p(P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v))$ and $z_*=P(u,v)$, truncation gives $\|\widetilde z-z_*\|_\infty<2\delta+\eta$, and $\widetilde z$ is a disk grid array. The opposite procedure returns $\widetilde h$ with $\|\widetilde h-\mathcal T_+\widetilde z\|_\infty<\delta$, and $\|\mathcal T_+(\widetilde z-z_*)\|_\infty\le\|\widetilde z-z_*\|_\infty$ since $\mathcal T_+$ is a contraction. The triangle inequality gives $\|\widetilde h-\mathcal T_+z_*\|_\infty<3\delta+\eta$. The exact multiplication by $M$ gives total error less than $M(3\delta+\eta)=\sqrt2\,M(3\ell+1)2^{-p}$

symbols.name: pointwise product
symbols.meaning: The pointwise product $uv/r$ of two arrays of ring elements, not a prefix count or a subspace.
symbols.quote: Write $P(u,v)=uv/r$ for the pointwise product (here $P$ is not a prefix count or a subspace).

symbols.name: layout permutation
symbols.meaning: The permutation of records made by the tape layout, not a linear map, a loss or a chunk length.
symbols.quote: with $L$ the layout permutation of records (not a linear map, a loss or a chunk length)

symbols.name: bit-reversal order
symbols.meaning: The bit-reversal order of records, not a complement, a level factor or a row length.
symbols.quote: $B$ the bit-reversal order (not a complement, a level factor or a row length)

symbols.name: log of record length
symbols.meaning: The base-2 logarithm of the record length r; not a depth.
symbols.quote: With $\ell=\log_2r$ (here $\ell$ is not a depth), each procedure maps disk grid arrays to disk grid arrays with error less than $\delta=\sqrt2\ell\,2^{-p}$

symbols.name: forward error bound
symbols.meaning: The bound on the error of each forward or opposite transform procedure, $\sqrt2\ell 2^{-p}$.
symbols.quote: each procedure maps disk grid arrays to disk grid arrays with error less than $\delta=\sqrt2\ell\,2^{-p}$

symbols.name: truncation error bound
symbols.meaning: The bound $\sqrt2\,2^{-p}$ on the change made by one truncation; not a relative deficit.
symbols.quote: which changes it by less than $\eta=\sqrt2\,2^{-p}$ (a truncation error bound, not a relative deficit)

symbols.name: layout chunk width
symbols.meaning: The width in bits of an address chunk in the tape layout; not a tensor line or a segment spacing.
symbols.quote: with $K$ the layout chunk width (not a tensor line or a segment spacing)

relations.quote: The transforms are laid out as in [Tape layout for synthetic transforms](transform-layout.md).
Each record product is formed by [Signed packing](signed-packing.md) in $O(rp\log(rp))$ time
The procedure keeps the retained order of [Retained frequency order](frequency-order.md), passing the product to the opposite transform without reordering.
